context: Asuka and Riku tour a historic building.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: architecture visit; structure vocabulary (建物/壁/入る/そのまま/もと) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: この建物、すごく古いですね。
lines.style: impressed teen boy voice, soft warm curious engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: もとは、お城だった建物ですよ。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 中に、入ってもいいんですか?
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、静かに入りましょう。
lines.style: gentle teacher voice, soft warm guiding clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 壁が、もとの色のままですね。
lines.en: The walls are still their original color.
lines.style: observant teen boy voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、壁はそのまま残されています。
lines.en: Yes, the walls are preserved as they were.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昔の人が、ここに入ったんですね。
lines.style: reflective teen boy voice, soft warm wonder throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: もとの姿を、そのまま感じられますね。
lines.en: You can feel its original form just as it was.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured clarity closing throughout
